nodes.text: What are you doing? You almost crushed me!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Saboteur!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You guys can't send L.Y.L.E. out there again! It'll be destroyed!
The nerds all share knowing glances with each other.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? What is it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Owen, we all know what you're going through right now. We've all been there.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I remember my first time at a battlebot competition. I cried when my bot, I Wedge Allegiance, got knocked out.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awww! You cried?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Well, I was `really` young!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I was [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] young!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: For me, it was Brendizzle Junior.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Mine was Father of the Gear.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I miss my first robot everyday... Hope you're doing okay in robot heaven, Robot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We came to the competition knowing we'd probably lose L.Y.L.E.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But you've worked so hard on him... Er, `it...` You know what I mean.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you've worked so hard on him... Er, [color=#e23b3b][i]it...[/i][/color] You know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We came here with a purpose, Owen. And nothing can deter us.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just because Round 1 didn't go according to plan, that doesn't mean we give up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It means we send L.Y.L.E. out there and give that Shock'N'Saw jerk-bot everything we've got in Round 2!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Cheesy life lessons aside, we are kind of in a crunch here! So... Little help?!
Kimi slaps Owen across the face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow! What is with girls slapping me today?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry, I got a little crazy there...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But how could you think she's actually chosen Cromwell?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, she's with him, isn't she?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, for, like, a day! You think what the two of you had is better than a day with some rich dude?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I don't think that at all.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not the problem here. `She` thinks it. And even if it is wrong...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not the problem here. [color=#e23b3b][i]She[/i][/color] thinks it. And even if it is wrong...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...She made her opinion of me crystal clear at the ball.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What do you mean, 'changed'?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's... She's not the Paige I used to know.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I think whatever's going on at that school has warped her, like a piece of plastic in the sun.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, warp her back, Owen!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's just it. I don't think there's anything `I` can do!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's just it. I don't think there's anything [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] can do!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think this new Paige is even capable of saying `awwwwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think this new Paige is even capable of saying [color=#e23b3b][i]awwwwww![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I just... I know how great you guys would be together.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, well, she made her opinion of me crystal clear at the ball.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Okay! I will fight you now for besmirching my honor!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Besmirching? Did you actually just say besmirching?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are afraid then?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What makes you think I am pompous?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Other than of course how much better I am than you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But that is a fact, not an opinion.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do I need to point out all the irony?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You think it is wrong to care so much about appearances?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I find this very disturbing considering how much you stick out like a...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Like a very ugly thumb.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No further questions. I rest my case. Scumbag-ism proved!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: If I am a clown with a beaver face as you say...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You are.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Then you are the bear that I make do all my tricks for me.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: With a little hat and a tricycle.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What weird circus is this?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And what bizarre website did you find this guy on, Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Dear'? Who do you think `you` are?
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Dear'? Who do you think [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] are?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ha! This one is like you, Paige. All fire.
Cromwell grows serious as he catches the look between Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You know my date? How? You are just a lowly wage worker!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it with rich people and insulting me?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And she's not interested in you, believe me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pfft! I'll decide who `I'm` interested in, thanks!
nodes.text_bbcode: Pfft! I'll decide who [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] interested in, thanks!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: The lady has spoken. You should leave...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But a word of advice... I suggest a different career, like running an oil company or becoming an investment banker.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Anything that does not make you wear such embarrassing clothes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is a tuxedo!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But it is obviously not custom-made. Please, `please` stop talking. I am afraid you will cause yourself more shame.
nodes.text_bbcode: But it is obviously not custom-made. Please, [color=#e23b3b][i]please[/i][/color] stop talking. I am afraid you will cause yourself more shame.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Bwahaha! This is the best moment of my life!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, really? This guy? You want to be with this... This...
Owen catches her wrist, her hand an inch from his face!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Careful. Before you do something you regret.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I regret the day I met you. Now let go!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Is this man-servant deserving of punishment, Paige, dear?
Owen lets go of Paige's wrist, sizing Cromwell up.
Owen is too slow to react!
Paige slaps him hard across the face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How could you?! After everything I did to come find you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Would you just listen to me for one--

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Is this man-servant deserving of punishment, Paige, dear?
Owen has failed...
`Just so you know...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Just so you know...[/b]

nodes.text: Paige gives Owen's arm a playful punch.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I think I've taken enough of a beating today, thanks!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee!
Owen pulls her in for another kiss, and this one lasts for what seems like forever.
Finally...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Who is that down there with that ruffian?! It better not be one of my girls?!
Whitford descends down the restaurant steps toward Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do we do?! I'm stuck at Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll get you back to Twin Branches, I swear. Until then, we'll make this work.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Us.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So there is an us?
As Whitford nears, Owen climbs up onto his horse.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah. There's definitely an `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah. There's definitely an [color=#e23b3b][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Awwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Awwww![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He rides off!
You have reached the end of `Season 5, Episode 8: Debutante Dance, Part Two!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 5, Episode 8: Debutante Dance, Part Two![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
Want to catch up?
Season 4: Love and Basketball is available in More Episodes now!
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I care about you more than I've cared about anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up. You're going to make this weird.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I haven't been myself without you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You make me feel... More like me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine! `I'll` shut you up!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! [color=#3b78e2][i]I'll[/i][/color] shut you up!

nodes.text: Paige pulls Owen close!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, I love--
--They kiss! And as they kiss, Paige melts into Owen's arms, trembling.
At long last, they part.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did... Did you just say that you love me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I said, 'I love--' and then you cut me off.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was going to say, 'I love the ocean.'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're totally right. You can't make me do anything I don't want to do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You jerk!
Paige smacks him on the arm!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow! Hey! I think I've had enough punishment for one day!
Owen expects to get some kind of playful ribbing back from Paige, but instead she just looks out over the water...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Idiot! Tell her how you feel!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige...
She turns to him, but her eyes go wide! Owen looks behind him and sees a police officer barreling toward him.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You!
The old man who sold Thunder to Owen is huffing and puffing behind Officer Monte.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: That's him!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Did you steal this horse?!

nodes.speaker: Thunder
nodes.text: Priit!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! No! He let me rent it!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: For how much?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Seven bucks!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Ridiculous! My going rate is $100... At least, I think it is... Wait, where am I?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ha! You're coming with me, horse thief!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen is not a horse thief!
Paige whispers to Owen under her breath...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You didn't steal the horse, did you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Why are you all beat up?!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: `I` did that when he tried to steal my horse from me!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] did that when he tried to steal my horse from me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Enough out of you! We'll get this settled downtown at the station! Come along!
Monte grabs Owen by the arm and drags him away.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait! There's something I have to tell Paige!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Do you want to add resisting arrest to the list of charges you're facing?!
Owen shakes his head and looks back...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I should have told her how I felt when I had the chance!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe... Maybe I'll get another opportunity after I get out of this--
Owen's thought is interrupted when he sees Cromwell run down the steps of the restaurant and return to Paige!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Son of a--
But it's too late! They've already reached Officer Monte's police cruiser.
Monte shoves Owen into the back. The old man waggles a finger at Owen from the other side of the glass.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: No one steals my Thunder!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's okay. Paige isn't going to be suckered in by that guy! After all, he beat me up, `and` he snatched her necklace!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's okay. Paige isn't going to be suckered in by that guy! After all, he beat me up, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] he snatched her necklace!

nodes.text: Meanwhile, back on the beach...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Forgive me, Paige, my dear. I was blind with rage at the thought of losing you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not going to forgive you that easily. You beat up Owen, `and` you snatched my--
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not going to forgive you that easily. You beat up Owen, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] you snatched my--

nodes.text: Cromwell holds up a pair of car keys.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I bought you a new car for apologies.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Eep! Ohmygosh!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I am forgiven?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Oh, yeah. Whatever.
Paige takes the keys, and Cromwell escorts her off!
Many months later...
Paige is sitting on a throne, bedecked in jewels, inside her massive personal mansion.
Two of her servants are riding miniature ponies on a loop around the massive hall.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is boring. Servants! Go buy me some new clothes to try on...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And this time, make sure they're `all` from Paris!
nodes.text_bbcode: And this time, make sure they're [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] from Paris!

nodes.text: Cromwell arrives.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And how is my queen?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm bored!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Well, maybe my queen would like to travel with me... For once.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Your queen is not really interested in traveling with you since all you do is talk about your money!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I am `so` sorry for this personal flaw. Here, this is the location of the jet I bought you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] sorry for this personal flaw. Here, this is the location of the jet I bought you.

nodes.text: Cromwell hands Paige a slip of paper with an address on it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: My own jet?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: This way you may travel without me. But we might still spend time together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... Great.
Cromwell kisses Paige.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I love you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I know you do not love me, but I do not care! Just knowing you are mine is enough!
Cromwell leaves... And in this moment of loneliness, all Paige can think of is Owen...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Stop, Paige! I'm better off without him. After all, he couldn't even tell me how he felt!
Meanwhile, at Twin Branches, Owen has adopted a rather annoying habit...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hi, Amanda... Just so you know, you're kind of an airhead...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe you should study more...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What?! Why would you say that?!
Amanda runs off crying.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Jill. Just so you know... You've been here at this school for a long time, and no one knows anything about you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe you should work on your personality...
Jill runs off crying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen! What's gotten into you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I can't help it! Ever since Paige left me, I have to tell everyone the truth!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Otherwise, it might be too late!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you think you're being ridiculous?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, and just so you know, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A lot of people like you, but a lot of people hate you too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? People hate me? Why? I try to be nice to everyone!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's exactly why.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, if being nice makes people hate me, maybe I should start being mean...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that what you're saying?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, no, but--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll start with you. You're nothing but a... A horrible person who says mean things!
$ZOE runs off crying.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why didn't I just tell Paige how I felt...
By now it should be very `very` clear that...
nodes.text_bbcode: By now it should be very [b]very[/b] clear that...

nodes.text: He looks at her for a moment and then out at the water...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, I tried to break into Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You did?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like a dozen times! One time, I even made it all the way to right outside your window.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Creeper!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. I overheard you say something about cute, rich boys.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You didn't get jealous, did you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why do you think I'm here, battered and bleeding?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I think you're here because you care about me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, what did you just say?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're really going to make me say it again?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like I'm capable of making you do anything you don't want to do.
Owen reaches out and gently holds Paige's face in his hand.
The pressure Paige applies to his lip eases slightly.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you mean?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's an acting technique. You imagine something that conjures up the emotions you want...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I imagined kissing you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And what emotion were you conjuring?
Owen can feel his cheeks flush with color...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Didn't mean anything?!
The pressure on Owen's lip intensifies!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow... And no! It didn't! It was just a kiss for the play!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, what about the fact that you kissed `me` the same way?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, what about the fact that you kissed [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] the same way?!

nodes.text: The pressure increases even more!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did `that` not mean anything either?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] not mean anything either?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! I mean--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!
Paige practically punches Owen again, grinding the washrag into his already torn lip!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow! Give me that!
Owen snatches it away!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Would you just stop for one second and think about the fact that I came here for you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: On a horse, I might add!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That `was` kinda hot.
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] kinda hot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Hrrk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrrk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As Owen sinks into the sand, he yanks Cromwell's leg, toppling him!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As the two get tangled up in the sand, Cromwell takes a handful and throws it in Owen's eyes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Pffthh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Pffthh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell pulls Owen to his feet!
Cromwell flies backward, falling face first into the sand!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Hffff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hffff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen turns to climb the stairs, but...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: My... My eye! Oh my eye! What have you done?!
Cromwell starts writhing in the sand!
Owen runs over to check on him...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Your eye?! Let me see--
--Cromwell tosses a handful of sand in Owen's face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Pffthh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Pffthh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell rises to his feet, laughing.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ha! What a softie!
As Owen struggles to regain vision, Cromwell hits him with a hard uppercut!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen falls backward, stumbling. A kick slams into his chest!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Hrrk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrrk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And a final, vicious punch cracks Owen's jaw! He stumbles back into a small stream of ocean water...
And then falls to his knees in the muddy sand around it, helpless and exposed!
Cromwell cocks his fist back!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And to all, a good night!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige is running across the sand towards them.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't hit him! Get back! Go away!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But, my dear, I am about to `win` the fight. We can go live our dreamy life together.
nodes.text_bbcode: But, my dear, I am about to [color=#e23b3b][i]win[/i][/color] the fight. We can go live our dreamy life together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want your dreamy life!
Paige drops down into the sand next to Owen, cradling his face.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But he is muddy. And a weakling. And he has nothing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's got everything I want.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's... He's my perfect person.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Paige, now... Now I am the one who is speechless.
He reaches down to Paige, as if pleading with her...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm `so` sorry, Cromwell... And I'm never sorry about anything...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry, Cromwell... And I'm never sorry about anything...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Neither was I until now!
Cromwell snatches the necklace off of Paige's neck!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Thank you for wasting my time!
He storms off, leaving Paige and Owen alone on the beach...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What took you so dang long?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up and come inside so we can get some ice on your face. You don't want it to swell up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The last thing you want is to be poor `and` ugly.
nodes.text_bbcode: The last thing you want is to be poor [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] ugly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: At least you're not adding insult to injury...
Paige tugs Owen, but he doesn't budge.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How about I stay here, not moving, and you bring the ice out to me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Assuming you can do something nice for someone else for once in your life.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll see if I can stomach it... Says the girl who just saved you from getting knocked back to last Tuesday.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't hear that. Maybe because I've got too much `blood` in my ear canal!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry. I didn't hear that. Maybe because I've got too much [color=#e23b3b][i]blood[/i][/color] in my ear canal!

nodes.text: A moment later, Paige and Owen are sitting in the sand while Paige tends to Owen's wounds.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Seriously? Are you just, like, a huge baby?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Next time we'll switch roles, and you can fight for `my` honor.
nodes.text_bbcode: Next time we'll switch roles, and you can fight for [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] honor.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just sit still!
A silence settles between them, filled by the sound of the waves crashing against the shore.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... About the kiss you saw between me and $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh huh.
Owen feels Paige adding pressure to his lip.
Owen tries to land a fourth jab, but Cromwell blocks it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh!
Cromwell gathers himself and slams Owen with a hard right cross!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Kitchen!
Owen hits Cromwell with a devastating right cross!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell teeters on his feet...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: In my grandma's!
Owen is too slow to land a third jab!
Cromwell gathers himself and slams Owen with a hard right cross!
Another jab!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Hrk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Trained!
Owen is too slow to land a second jab!
Cromwell gathers himself and slams Owen with a hard right cross!
Owen hits Cromwell with a swift jab to the face!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Hkk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hkk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well I!
Missing the opportunity, Cromwell breaks Owen's block and slams Owen with a hard right cross!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You say you trained all over the world?
Owen catches Cromwell's arm with his own!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Huh?!
Surprised, Cromwell leaves himself exposed.
Owen tries to duck down, but he ends up right in the path of the overhand punch!
Cromwell's fist hits him squarely on the temple!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was dumb of me...
Before Cromwell can throw another punch, Owen rises quickly to his feet!
The quick movement catches Cromwell off-guard!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Who is the clown now?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If she can handle looking at your ugly, beaver-nosed, dumb-as-dumb-can-get, clown face--

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Hey!
Owen gallops his horse up to the restaurant and dismounts!

nodes.speaker: Thunder
nodes.text: Prrrrit!
Owen starts to climb the stairs to the balcony when Cromwell descends, blocking him!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You can stop right there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I need to talk to you, Paige!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: --She does not talk to garbage cans like you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How can you offer me all this when you don't even know me?!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What is there to know?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are more beautiful than the necklace I have given you.
Paige blushes.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: More full of life than any of the girls I have met all over the world.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How many girls?!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Never mind that.
Cromwell takes Paige's hands into his own.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: As you may know, I have lots and lots of money.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You may have mentioned that.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But I have no one to share it with. No perfect person to love the way I love my money.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But you are that perfect person.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I know that I will love you because I don't care that you only have one mansion.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: A girl like you is precious, and I would do anything to protect you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Paige, if I had to, in a very bizarre circumstance, I would jump through hoops for you!
As Owen reaches the end of the tunnel, he trips a sensor!
Three large hoops descend from the ceiling, forming an unavoidable path out!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You've `got` to be kidding.
nodes.text_bbcode: You've [color=#e23b3b][i]got[/i][/color] to be kidding.

nodes.text: The hoops burst into flames!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! Please! Go back to not on fire!
Owen looks back down the tunnel the other way.

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: I would not go that way. Hot. Hooooooooot.
Owen steels himself.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm here for a reason. The nerds wouldn't give up. I won't either!
He sprints down the tunnel, toward the hoops, his legs pumping furiously! When he gets to the end, he...
Owen tries to get by Cromwell, but Cromwell shoves him back.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are not so good at listening.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not here to fight you, man.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Then you are in for a rough time, because I am going to fight you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why? Are you afraid of what I might say to Paige?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: She did not like whatever you said to her last time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She doesn't like what I say to her `ever.`
nodes.text_bbcode: She doesn't like what I say to her [color=#e23b3b][i]ever.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige stifles a laugh, and Cromwell shoots her an angry look.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? It's true.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm just going to talk to her for five minutes, and then I'll be out of your over-groomed hair.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You seem to still think that is an option.
Cromwell gives Owen another shove, pushing him back to the sand.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, really? He won't even let me `talk` to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige, really? He won't even let me [color=#e23b3b][i]talk[/i][/color] to you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: That is enough!
Cromwell punches Owen in the gut, causing Owen to double over!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oof... Still you, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are not going to fight back?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I told you...
Owen rises to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not here to fight.
Cromwell socks Owen hard in the face, knocking him backwards and cutting open his lip!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Hrk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are what they call a weakling then.
Cromwell calls back to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: He does not fight because he is obviously no match...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: While I have trained all over the world!
Cromwell turns his attention back to Owen, and rears back, throwing a hard, overhand punch!
This time, Owen...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Great work, everyone! And just in time, too! The next round's starting right now!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Get ready to see the fruits of your manly sweat, O-dog!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'd love to, but--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But?
The nerds all turn to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. I kinda sorta am leaving you all again... Please don't hate me.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What?! But this is probably the last we'll see of L.Y.L.E.!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, but I just learned something... Something pretty huge, actually.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I came here for a purpose... To get Paige back...
Kimi gasps.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And just like you guys and L.Y.L.E., I got completely crushed in the first round.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeeeeeeee--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But just like you guys with L.Y.L.E, I need to go back out there...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Eeeeeeeeep!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Even if it means getting completely crushed again.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I think I can speak for most of us, especially Kimi, when I say, 'Why are you still talking to us?! Go find her!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah! And disrupt her power circuits! Er... Whatever the metaphorical equivalent of that is!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The rule might be ro-bros before--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nope!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Er... But I've also heard people say it's romance before platonic relationships...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's also not a phrase that anyone has used. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, gotta go! L.Y.L.E.... Good luck!

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: You too, human.
Owen takes off through the convention center, but before he can make much progress, Kimi grabs him!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: First! Ohmygosh! Ohmygosh! I'm so excited! But...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm surprised there's a 'but' to that sentence.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But second! How are you going to find Paige? The Debutante Dance is probably over by now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, you're totally right. Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, if I know Paige, she's probably out with that Cromwell doof.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And that means they're somewhere rich people go, somewhere she can get him to spend money on her.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's still kind of vague...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But she also wasn't interested in the food I was serving. I bet she made Cromwell take her out to a fancy restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you have internet access on your phone?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, Captain 1950's, of course.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, tell me the name of fancy restaurants along the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Here's one called `The Love Ship.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Here's one called [color=#3b78e2][i]The Love Ship.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: There's another called `Anglers Away.`
nodes.text_bbcode: There's another called [color=#3b78e2][i]Anglers Away.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: One called `Betty's Chowderhouse.`
nodes.text_bbcode: One called [color=#3b78e2][i]Betty's Chowderhouse.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And a smaller place just called `Max's.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And a smaller place just called [color=#3b78e2][i]Max's.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It sounds egotistical, but I'm positive she'd pick one that would remind her of me...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Even subtly... But which one?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If Paige `is` getting dinner, I probably don't have much time before she leaves the restaurant!
nodes.text_bbcode: If Paige [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] getting dinner, I probably don't have much time before she leaves the restaurant!

nodes.text: Owen starts to sprint toward the beachfront walkway, when he's stopped in his tracks!
Nearby, an old man is feeding a beautiful black horse.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How much to rent your horse, sir?

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: One hundred dollars, and he's yours for the next two hours!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I don't have that much.

nodes.speaker: Thunder
nodes.text: Priiit!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Well, how much have you got?
Owen rifles through his pockets, knowing already there isn't going to be nearly enough.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Never mind. I've only got... Uh, seven bucks.
Owen turns away, wondering how he'll ever make it in time, when the old man calls out to him!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Wait one minute, Sonny! You look like someone who needs this horse a lot more than the tourists, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's kind of important, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Well, it just so happens that my fee this late drops to seven dollars for as long as you need ol' Thunder here.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You serious?

nodes.speaker: Thunder
nodes.text: Priiit!
The old man hands him the reins and shoots him a wink.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: As serious as a broken heart.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... I like what you're saying, Cromwell.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Of course you do. I am saying wonderful things.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I also imagine you are excited to not go to horror school anymore, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Once you are with me, we will travel the world together!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Travel? You never said anything about traveling!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I do not live here, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where do you live?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Everywhere and nowhere. The world is my home. We can explore it together!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: That is what this whole day has been about... Will you experience the world with me?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are speechless again because my offer is so amazing?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Air! I need some air!
Paige gets up from her seat in a hurry and rushes outside!
Out on the restaurant's balcony, the cool sea air blows against Paige's face.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is everything I wanted... But is it really what I `want?`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is everything I wanted... But is it really what I [color=#3b78e2][i]want?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: In the distance, she hears a voice calling out.

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Paaaaaaaige! Paaaaaaaige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Am I that hung up on Owen? Now I'm hearing his voice...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't be stupid, Paige.
Paige casually turns, looking down along the beach...
Her voice catches in her throat. Owen is there, riding up to her on a magnificent stallion!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige!
At that moment, Cromwell steps out onto the balcony. He sees the look on Paige's face...
...And starts rolling up his sleeves!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I see trouble has returned.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I am going to end this. Stay back, dear. This is about to get ugly.
In the restaurant...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So when you say there's nothing you wouldn't do for me...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Name it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I wanted to live in a mansion all my own?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It is yours.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I wanted jewelry, like this emerald piece, every day?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Also, yours.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What if I wanted--

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: --Paige, you will want for nothing, `need` for nothing.
nodes.text_bbcode: --Paige, you will want for nothing, [color=#e23b3b][i]need[/i][/color] for nothing.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And there is no obstacle that I would let get in the way of your happiness...
At Robo-Con, Owen sprints through the tunnel...
...And trips over a robot!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: Enemy! Enemy! Engaging monkey trap!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do I even want to know what that is?!
Before Owen can get to his feet, the monkey-robot fires a rope and quickly wraps it around Owen's legs, working up to his body!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How is this even related to monkeys?!

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: None of your monkey business, enemy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, turn off, now! Not an enemy!

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: Does not compute!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, stop the trap!

nodes.speaker: ROBOMONKEY
nodes.text: Invalid command.
The rope is now around Owen's elbows, heading up his arms!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just have to say the right commands!
He twists his way through the maze, reaching the beginning of the large, pitch-black tunnel.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was easy! Now all I have to do is get to the end of the tunnel, and I'll be on my way to Paige!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We came to the competition knowing we'd probably lose L.Y.L.E.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But you've worked so hard on him... Er, `it...` You know what I mean.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you've worked so hard on him... Er, [color=#e23b3b][i]it...[/i][/color] You know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We came here with a purpose, Owen. And nothing can deter us.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just because Round 1 didn't go according to plan, that doesn't mean we give up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It means we send L.Y.L.E. out there and give that Shock'N'Saw jerk-bot everything we've got in Round 2!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Cheesy life lessons aside, we are kind of in a crunch here! So... Little help?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm about to do this...
From outside, he quickly traces the maze...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Left, Right, Left! Then it's a clear path through that tunnel to the end, right near the lot!
He ducks into the maze! When he comes to the first fork, he turns...
A moment later, Paige and Owen are sitting in the sand while Paige tends to Owen's wounds.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Seriously? Are you just, like, a huge baby?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Next time we'll switch roles, and you can fight for `my` honor.
nodes.text_bbcode: Next time we'll switch roles, and you can fight for [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] honor.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just sit still!
A silence settles between them, filled by the sound of the waves crashing against the shore.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... About the kiss you saw between me and $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh huh.
Owen feels Paige adding pressure to his lip.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ha! What a softie!
As Owen struggles to regain vision, Cromwell hits him with a hard uppercut!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen falls backward, stumbling. A kick slams into his chest!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Hrrk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrrk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And a final, vicious punch cracks Owen's jaw! He stumbles back into a small stream of ocean water...
And then falls to his knees in the muddy sand around it, helpless and exposed!
Cromwell cocks his fist back!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And to all, a good night!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige is running across the sand towards them.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't hit him! Get back! Go away!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But, my dear, I am about to `win` the fight. We can go live our dreamy life together.
nodes.text_bbcode: But, my dear, I am about to [color=#e23b3b][i]win[/i][/color] the fight. We can go live our dreamy life together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want your dreamy life!
Paige drops down into the sand next to Owen, cradling his face.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But he is muddy. And a weakling. And he has nothing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's got everything I want.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's... He's my perfect person.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Paige, now... Now I am the one who is speechless.
He reaches down to Paige, as if pleading with her...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm `so` sorry, Cromwell... And I'm never sorry about anything...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry, Cromwell... And I'm never sorry about anything...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Neither was I until now!
Cromwell snatches the necklace off of Paige's neck!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Thank you for wasting my time!
He storms off, leaving Paige and Owen alone on the beach...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What took you so dang long?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up and come inside so we can get some ice on your face. You don't want it to swell up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The last thing you want is to be poor `and` ugly.
nodes.text_bbcode: The last thing you want is to be poor [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] ugly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: At least you're not adding insult to injury...
Paige tugs Owen, but he doesn't budge.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How about I stay here, not moving, and you bring the ice out to me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Assuming you can do something nice for someone else for once in your life.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll see if I can stomach it... Says the girl who just saved you from getting knocked back to last Tuesday.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't hear that. Maybe because I've got too much `blood` in my ear canal!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry. I didn't hear that. Maybe because I've got too much [color=#e23b3b][i]blood[/i][/color] in my ear canal!

nodes.text: Cromwell flies backward, falling face first into the sand!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: `Hffff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hffff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen turns to climb the stairs, but...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: My... My eye! Oh my eye! What have you done?!
Cromwell starts writhing in the sand!
Owen runs over to check on him...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Your eye?! Let me see--
--Cromwell tosses a handful of sand in Owen's face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Pffthh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Pffthh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell rises to his feet, laughing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I think you're here because you care about me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, what did you just say?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're really going to make me say it again?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like I'm capable of making you do anything you don't want to do.
Owen reaches out and gently holds Paige's face in his hand.
Owen gallops his horse up to the restaurant and dismounts!

nodes.speaker: Thunder
nodes.text: Prrrrit!
Owen starts to climb the stairs to the balcony when Cromwell descends, blocking him!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You can stop right there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I need to talk to you, Paige!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: --She does not talk to garbage cans like you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Of a pompous jerk? No. You guys are all inflated and full of yourselves.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It isn't hard to bring you back down to size.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Go ahead and try.
Owen takes a step toward Cromwell...
...But suddenly Paige puts herself between them, purposefully making eye contact with Owen before pulling Cromwell in for a long, long kiss!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige...
At last, after an interminable moment, Paige and Cromwell separate...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: For the first time, I know true bliss.

nodes.speaker: Paige
